name: 34990 · Palm City, FL
findings: ZIP 34990 (Palm City) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34990 (Palm City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34990 (Palm City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: No social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
